purpose: Close the LAST known W2-B5 closed-world authority gap, the one W2-B5-CLOSURE-OBLIGATIONS-HPO-ADJUDICATION-R1 classified as its single BLOCKING finding: two EXISTING product test hosts render the RunDetail page the frozen B5 contract commands FIBIU-17/FIBIU-18 to extend, and neither host is inside the B5 closed world, so no mission may wire them. It authorizes NO new FIBIU scope, NO migration, NO schema change, NO behavioral delta, NO production-semantics change and NO B5 semantic change of any kind.
scope_note: This amendment adds THREE exact literal paths and NOTHING else. No wildcard. No directory. No 'related files'. No allowlist derived from a diff. The three paths are NOT interchangeable and carry TWO DIFFERENT authorized change classes, stated per path and separately controlled.

amended_authorized_surface.change_classes_are_not_interchangeable: BINDING. MOCK_OR_TEST_WIRING_ONLY authorizes path_1 and path_2 and NOTHING about path_3. DOCUMENTATION_ALIGNMENT_ONLY authorizes path_3 and NOTHING about path_1 or path_2. A change of the wrong class on an authorized path is as unauthorized as a change to an unauthorized path.

precedent_prohibition.BINDING: This amendment MUST NOT be cited to infer any future path.
precedent_prohibition.rule: The authorization of these three paths creates NO precedent for a fourth. It licenses no pattern, no directory, no family, no 'same kind of thing' and no analogical extension. An eighth mechanically or governance forced path - in any batch, in any lane, at any time - is a fresh STOP_FOR_AUTHORITY_DELTA requiring its own governed amendment with its own per-path necessity proof and, where ODS prohibited_surfaces is engaged, its own explicit ODS instruction.
specifically_prohibited_inferences: that tests/** is now open, or that any test rendering a B5-touched page is automatically authorized
that any test host whose mocks desynchronise against an authorized implementation is automatically authorized
that tests/*.ui.test.tsx, tests/run-detail-page*, or any other naming family is now open
that docs/** is now open, or that any documentation file made stale by an authorized change is automatically authorized
that DOCUMENTATION_ALIGNMENT_ONLY is a general licence to edit documentation during an implementation mission
that MOCK_OR_TEST_WIRING_ONLY permits any change to an assertion, an it() case or a describe block
that a governance-forced path may be authorized without an explicit necessity statement distinguishing it from a gate-forced one
that a path is authorized because it is mechanically forced, without a governed authority object naming it
that 'it was already changed on a candidate branch' is ever a reason for authorization

that this amendment, by adding a second amendment to the same base authority, establishes that the B5 closed world may be extended routinely - two governed extensions with per-path proofs are two exceptions, not a process
precedent_prohibition.why_this_clause_exists: The recurring failure mode in this program is not an implementer inventing scope - it is a later mission reading a narrow, well-justified exception as a general permission. W2-B4's audit recorded a vacuous ODS_SCOPE=PASS obtained from a diff-derived allowlist. This amendment is the SECOND extension of the same frozen closed world, which raises that risk rather than lowering it, so the clause is restated in a strengthened form and asserted by deterministic controls.

test_and_mutation_contract.host_rationale: EXTENDED, NOT REPLACED, and no new filename is invented. That file is the repository-native host for controls asserting properties of the W2-B5 closed-world amendments - its name is the amendment family, not a version - and it already composes the v1.0.0 enumeration and the v1.0.1 additions with the REAL gate matcher. The decisive reason is technical, not stylistic: the non-vacuity and closed-world controls for THESE three paths must be evaluated against the surface that ALREADY includes v1.0.1's four, so a separate host would have to duplicate v1EnumerationPatterns() and re-read the v1.0.1 artifact - reintroducing exactly the reimplementation drift that host's own header warns against. tests/ods/ is the repository-native home for controls over governance artifacts and is separately authorized for THIS authority mission by docs/ops/ods/ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.18.json; v1.0.0 explicitly_prohibited reserves tests/ods/** against the IMPLEMENTATION mission, a correct rule that binds that mission and not this one.
test_and_mutation_contract.host_edit_discipline: STRICTLY ADDITIVE. Every existing line of the host is left byte-unchanged. The v1.0.1 constants EXPECTED_FOUR, ADDED, V1_PATTERNS and EFFECTIVE_PATTERNS are NOT redefined, NOT reassigned and NOT widened, so every v1.0.1 control continues to assert exactly what it asserted before. The v1.0.2 controls introduce their own constants and their own effective surface.
test_and_mutation_contract.matcher_binding: Controls use matchesAnyPattern and DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS imported from scripts/ods-scope.ts so authorization is evaluated by the REAL gate matcher, never by a reimplementation that could drift from it.
positive_controls: POS-AMD2-1: each of the three exact paths is a member of amended_authorized_surface.additional_exact_paths.
POS-AMD2-2: each of the three exact paths IS authorized under the EFFECTIVE surface (v1.0.0 enumeration UNION v1.0.1's four UNION these three).

POS-AMD2-3 (NON-VACUITY): each of the three exact paths is NOT authorized under v1.0.0 ALONE, and NOT authorized under v1.0.0 UNION v1.0.1 either. Both directions are asserted, because a path already covered by v1.0.1 would make this amendment vacuous for it and POS-AMD2-2 would prove nothing.

POS-AMD2-4: the composed predecessor surface is non-trivial - the v1.0.0 enumeration composes to at least 40 patterns and still authorizes its own known members - so POS-AMD2-3 cannot pass because the surface was accidentally emptied.
negative_controls: NEG-AMD2-1: an adjacent third test is NOT authorized. Named explicitly for a sibling of each authorized path, including a same-prefix test host, so 'the test next to it' is proven unauthorized rather than merely unmentioned.
NEG-AMD2-2: a wildcard is NOT authorized - no entry contains '*' or '**', and tests/**, tests/*.test.tsx, docs/** and docs/*.md are proven non-members.
NEG-AMD2-3: a directory-prefix inference is REJECTED - tests/, tests/ods/ and docs/ are neither members nor authorized, and every entry carries a file extension and does not end in '/'.

NEG-AMD2-4: a production path is REJECTED - representative app/**, lib/** and db/migrations/** paths outside the frozen enumeration are proven unauthorized under the effective surface, so this amendment is shown not to have opened any production surface.

NEG-AMD2-5: the amendment grants NO protected surface - none of the three matches DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS, the companion addendum declares no grant, and PROTECTED_GRANTS cardinality is unchanged at 10.

NEG-AMD2-6 (THE DOCS-RIDER SPLIT): docs/20_STELLA_ROLE_CONTRACTS.md is authorized by THIS Wave2 amendment and is NOT a member of the companion ODS addendum's product-test instruction. Asserted in both directions - present in the Wave2 list, absent from the ODS list - so the rider cannot be silently transformed into an ODS-protected product-test grant.
NEG-AMD2-7: the frozen predecessors are declared byte-unchanged, and the two authorized change classes are declared non-interchangeable.
mutation_controls: MUT-AMD2-1: REMOVE either product-test path => that path becomes unauthorized under the effective surface, while the other two remain authorized. Asserted for each of the three independently, so no single path can silently drop out and the failure is precise rather than collateral.
MUT-AMD2-2: ADD an unrelated path => exact-membership and the closed-world count assertion fail.
MUT-AMD2-3: CASE-CORRUPT an exact path => the corrupted spelling is NOT authorized, proving authorization is bound to canonical casing. Asserted for all three paths.
MUT-AMD2-4: WIDEN a product-test path to its directory glob => an adjacent third test that must not be authorized becomes authorized, proving the exact-path form is load-bearing.

MUT-AMD2-5: MOVE the docs rider into the ODS instruction => the ODS path count and the exact-set equality against the two product-test paths both fail, proving NEG-AMD2-6 is enforced by cardinality and not only by absence.
test_and_mutation_contract.closed_world_proof: EXACT MEMBERSHIP, never a subset test: the additional path list is asserted to have length 3, to contain no duplicates, and to equal the expected three-element set exactly - in both directions. The ODS instruction list is asserted to have length 2 and to equal the two product-test paths exactly, in both directions.
test_and_mutation_contract.gate_weakening_prohibited: No control in this file may be skipped, softened or converted to a lower-bound form to obtain a PASS. This applies to the v1.0.1 controls it already carries as much as to the v1.0.2 controls added here.

risks_and_open_findings.RISK_1_derived_rather_than_executed_nece: The runtime failure of path_1 and path_2 is DERIVED from static measurement - six unmocked specifiers, both hosts rendering the page, reads deliberately unguarded - and from a measured baseline showing both hosts pass today. It is NOT executed against a merged B5 implementation, because that implementation is not merged and this mission may not run or modify it. The mitigation is binding rather than rhetorical: each path's measurement_honesty clause REQUIRES the remediation mission to measure the concrete failure before wiring, and forbids wiring anything the measured failure does not require. If the measurement shows a host does NOT in fact break, the correct outcome is that its authorization goes unused - never that the wiring is applied anyway.
risks_and_open_findings.RISK_2_second_extension_of_the_same_clos: This is the SECOND governed extension of W2_B5_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json's closed world. Two extensions with per-path proofs are two exceptions, not a process, but the pattern itself invites a third author to treat extension as routine. Mitigated by the strengthened precedent_prohibition and its deterministic control, and disclosed here so an auditor weighs it directly.
risks_and_open_findings.RISK_3_docs_rider_bundled_with_gate_forc: path_3 is governance-forced while path_1 and path_2 are gate-forced, and bundling them in one instrument risks an auditor accepting the weaker case on the strength of the stronger. Mitigated by giving path_3 its own NECESSITY_CLASS, its own honesty clause, its own CAN_BE_REMOVED answer of YES, and its own exclusion control NEG-AMD2-6. If an auditor rejects path_3, the correct outcome is that path_3 alone loses authorization.
risks_and_open_findings.RISK_4_control_host_extension_could_dist: Extending tests/ods/w2-b5-scope-amendment.test.ts rather than creating a new host risks silently altering the v1.0.1 controls it already carries. Mitigated by host_edit_discipline - strictly additive, no existing constant redefined - and verifiable by diff: the v1.0.1 region of the file must be byte-unchanged.
